scope: Read-only original Android 6.1.1 Unity threading investigation; selector outcomes are static evidence, not a physical-device benchmark.

serialized_settings.limitation: Complete baked-field consumer linkage outside the explicit selector was not proved. False does not establish missing engine support.

selector.scope: Graphics Jobs disabled and no force-gfx-jobs string, unless explicitly stated

bool_parsing.unknown_input: Fallsbacktoregistered default byte; these boolregistrations initialize that byte0. No case-sensitivity claim about comparisonhelper0x6d913c.
bool_parsing.conclusion: gfx-disable-mt-rendering=0 is false, not merely keypresence=true. A presentkey withnull/emptyvalue is true. Numeric0 and absence have the same falsecondition inthis registeredoption context.

mode_observation.note: Engine registry omits optional empty parentheses; exact registry function key/native pointer pairing is proven. Public wrapper source evidence separately records actual literal and resolver.
mode_observation.graphicsMultiThreaded: No such original IL2CPP wrapper found in the targeted SystemInfo method inventory; absence may reflect stripping and is not evidence that MT is unavailable.

device_factory.mode_0_or_5: Direct backend creation path at0x819254; does not create this client-worker
device_factory.mode_1: Device client path, worker start skipped
device_factory.mode_2_3_4: Device client plus explicit worker start at0x819308→0xe913e8
device_factory.startup_log_format: GfxDevice: creating device client; threaded=%i; jobified=%i
device_factory.log_limit: Only client path emits this exact log; absence alone does not identify current mode.

worker_creation_chain.proof: Allocates Thread object, names it UnityGfxDeviceWorker, passes callback0xe914bc and renderer userdata toThread_start0x6f1768 at0xe91490.
Stores userdata/callback at Thread+0x38/+0x40; tail calls0x7c2018.
Loads pthread routine viaGOT0x145a000; calls actual pthread_create PLT0x140b1a0 at0x7c20b0, passing owning Thread asargument.
Original pthread trampoline loads saved userdata/callback fromThread+0x38/+0x40 and invokes callback withBLR at0x6f166c.

Runs backend operations through renderer+0x230 and vtable, then dispatches renderer work through virtual function. Retained complete FDE-bounded entry; downstream virtual implementation not exhaustively decoded.

original_Java_intent_argument_path.scope: Static DEX instructions, no command or device execution

compatibility_findings.direct_inventory_limit: Immediate B/BL only; indirect/virtual/inlined/native paths not exhausted
compatibility_findings.current_bridge_scope: First accepted pthread callback is recorded; this is not an official Unity main-thread-ID query. Readback/TID observation is required for MT compatibility.

limitations: Actual selected mode/backend on the reported physical phone
Whether a requested mode activates and remains stable for that backend/device
Any frame pacing, correctness, energy or performance benefit from enabling it
Complete PlayerSettings baked/runtime-consumer linkage outside the explicit selector
